description.p: Gomceix is a GNOME-style launcher for Minecraft Bedrock Edition on Linux. It downloads the game from the Microsoft Store with your own account, sets up everything the game needs, and starts it.

ul.li: Install and manage game versions, accounts, profiles, worlds and content
Real Xbox sign-in, so friends, servers and Realms work from inside the game
Light, dark and custom JSON themes, and a picture behind the Play banner
Requirements page that lists every component Gomceix downloads, each removable on its own
Diagnostics for your GPU and the game's Wine prefix
English, Turkish and Chinese interface, switchable at runtime

description.p: Gomceix does not contain or distribute Minecraft. A Minecraft licence linked to your Microsoft account is required. Gomceix is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.

ul.li: New GTK 4 and libadwaita interface with themes and backgrounds
Game download, sign-in, profiles, saves and content management
